corrections.finding: The multiword alias fixture query matched a shared alias word in both records. Corrected the QA fixture to use a unique alias; no app code correction was needed.
The QA explanation count included a reference-list item. Corrected the selector to count only distractor explanations; no app code correction was needed.
The delayed route test continued a released route. Corrected the test handler to capture then fulfill the response and wait for handler completion.

The new study notices could push Send underneath fixed mobile navigation while Coach used a fixed page height. Changed only mobile Coach layout to flow naturally and scroll controls clear of navigation. Failed scope 10 rerun passed; new scope 13 checked the impacted Send path.

Pending chat requests now retain their originally submitted condition IDs, so a lost completed reply remains replayable after the backend updates the conversation anchor. This new failure mode was found during code review and the focused browser regression passed on first run.
